field_evidence.proposal: Reserved Matters for appearance, landscaping, layout and scale for 32 residential dwellings.
field_evidence.finding: The official register exposes a distinct proposed House Type A1 drawing, but the register metadata does not provide an exact georeferenced per-building Polygon/MultiPolygon tied to a canonical_parcel_id. A house-type drawing alone is not proof of one distinct unfinished building footprint at a canonical parcel.
